scope: PhotonHash v0.3 boundary evidence and post-freeze platform audit

records.observed: Bit-exact fused same-matrix recurrence at four equal-work points; 227.97 to 257.83 uJ per core attempt at the NVML board boundary.
records.supports: Electronic adversary and equal-work dimension/round frontier.
records.does_not_support: Photonic energy, photonic exactness, or complete miner economics.

records.observed: Distinct resident matrices imposed no useful RTX 5090 penalty at a 128 MiB matrix-bank size.
records.supports: Strong fused electronic baseline for the feed-forward comparison.
records.does_not_support: A physically scalable optical stage bank.

records.observed: A 16 by 16 optical tensor processor reported about 250 fJ/MAC complete-system accounting, a projected 138 fJ/MAC with chip-scale modulators, measured residual standard deviation around 0.0025 for its demonstrated MMM, and explicit ADC/DAC scaling terms.
records.does_not_support: An 8192 by 8192 R1 transform, an exact wrap boundary, linked-round symbolic yield, or the projected scaling at R1 size.

records.observed: A StrongARM comparator study reported 15.2 fJ per comparison and 3 GHz operation.
records.supports: An optimistic lower bound for the comparator element alone.
records.does_not_support: Photodetection, threshold references, latching, routing, drive, remodulation, multi-threshold 4-bit conversion, or R1 error probability.

records.observed: Graphene-silicon photonic-crystal activators demonstrated a 4 fJ saturable-absorption threshold at 1.05 ps and a 30 fJ reconfigurable nonlinear-activation threshold around 4 ps.
records.supports: Energy and latency plausibility for a physical all-optical nonlinearity.
records.does_not_support: A hard consensus threshold, a 4-bit wrap transfer, deterministic ties, symbolic BER, or thousands of linked exact decisions.

records.observed: A monolithic photonic neural network integrated linear and nonlinear functions for six neurons and three layers with 410 ps latency.
records.supports: Physical feasibility of shallow integrated feed-forward nonlinear stages.
records.does_not_support: Large exact state width, exact discrete regeneration, deep symbolic yield, or R1 energy.

records.observed: LightHash experimentally studied robust low-bit photonic hashing and hardware-agnostic repetition to mitigate systematic error.
records.supports: The need to include systematic error, correlation, repetition energy, and digitally verifiable thresholds.
records.does_not_support: R1 recurrence, a large exact feedback boundary, or byte-exact yield across 16384 to 131072 linked decisions.

records.observed: An end-to-end on-chip photonic network demonstrated cascaded optoelectronic nonlinear activation at 64-channel scale.
records.supports: Feed-forward cascadability as an active experimental direction.
records.does_not_support: Consensus-exact behavior, R1 width, or a complete exact-attempt energy budget.

records.observed: Q.ANT publicly specifies a Gen-2 TFLN NPU with native nonlinear processing, matrix-vector access through C/C++ and Python, a Linux driver, PCIe Gen4 x8, 8 GOPS throughput, and a 150 W NPU power specification.
records.supports: An existing commercial platform for a representative matrix and nonlinear-boundary experiment.
records.does_not_support: An exact R1 wrap transition, operation-normalized complete energy, raw detector access, or conversion-free recurrent chaining.

records.observed: Q.ANT describes nonlinear operation through controlled PIC modulation as a weighted sinusoidal function of an input vector.
records.supports: A physically implemented smooth nonlinear transfer relevant to boundary experiments.
records.does_not_support: A stable public cosine API, a hard threshold, deterministic ties, low-bit wrap, or consensus-exact symbolic output.

records.observed: LRZ reports photodetection into digital electrical signals when further processing is required, on-card CMOS, continuous photonic-classical exchange, 16-bit conversion with detector noise, and Gen-1/Gen-2 workload and power evaluation.
records.supports: The existence of a hybrid detector/CMOS architecture and the need to audit the complete conversion path.
records.does_not_support: Per-boundary energy, exact error probability, raw intermediate access, or proof that recurrent native operations avoid full conversion.

records.observed: Q.ANT reports executing the TiRex xLSTM recurrent model and an iterative diffusion workload on its Gen-2 NPU.
records.supports: Software-level recurrence and repeated matrix-work execution on the available platform.
records.does_not_support: Optical state residency between recurrent steps, a conversion-free feedback path, or consensus-exact recurrence.

conclusion: No primary source demonstrates the complete exact nonlinear boundary required for an evidence-qualified R1 or feed-forward survivor.
